summary: On the target, check home folder space, copy the artifact (ideally to the gateway node, or the database node if space is tight), download the latest containerized installer, then in the container user's home run `sha256sum --check artifact.tar.sha256`, `tar xf artifact.tar` and `sha256sum --check sha256sum.txt` inside `artifact`.
questions: Where should I extract the migration artifact on the target?
How do I verify the artifact on the target node?
Which node should I work from on the target?

answer_card.title: Unpack the artifact on the target
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd ~
sha256sum --check artifact.tar.sha256
tar xf artifact.tar
cd artifact
sha256sum --check sha256sum.txt
```
Work from the gateway node (or the database node if space is tight).
